# Impulse

Source: [8044](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/8044); edited 2026-02-09. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-8044-n1"></a>

- Legacy Cancel Contrary Motion processes horizontal XZ and vertical Y separately; XYZ variant cancels opposing velocity with all axes together.

<a id="wiki-8044-n2"></a>

- Incorporate Contrary Motion adds impulse to existing velocity, so opposing motion can reduce observed movement.
